answer: The meadow test I would run is Attested dairyman licence with dairy farmers attestation: a licence farmers renew after herd audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What makes this stick is that a licence farmers renew after herd audits cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the zenith of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the nadir of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
